text:
Alex: Heads up — saw a perf regression on Mixtral-MoE serving this morning. Canary -> prod rollout triggered fallback. p95/p99 spiked, throughput down ~40%.
Alex: Initial look points at router logits variance; some requests touching 8-12 experts instead of expected 2-4. KV cache eviction heatmap shows thrash.
Priya: Can you paste the profiler output? :eyes: 
Alex: profiler snippet:
```
perf-summary:
  fused_attn_kernel: 58%
  router:topk_routing: 21%
  kv_cache:evict: 10%
  softmax: 2%
  other: 9%
```
Marco: Router top_k changed recently? I remember a rollout bump.
Alex: Yep — config bump last week: top_k 8 -> 12, router_temp 1.1. Config used in canary: 
```
model: mixtral-moe-v2
router:
  top_k: 12
  temp: 1.1
  logit_scale: 1.0
expert_parallelism: 2
expert_cache_capacity: 4096
```
Sam: Hypothesis: higher top_k => more experts per request => more KV lookups + memory pressure => kernel switches to slower pathways. Also RoPE scaling changes could affect token locality and routing.
Priya: We should test orthogonal fixes: (A) reduce top_k to 4-6, (B) increase per-expert cache capacity to reduce eviction thrash, (C) change kernel selection to tiled attention for long seq.
Danielle: Also double-check heads/kv dims — last Mixtral patch bumped kv_dim 64 -> 128 for some variants which doubles KV footprint.
Alex: Quick calc: KV size per token = heads * kv_dim. For 32 heads: 32*128=4096 floats ~= 16KB/token. That matches observed memory pressure.
Marco: I'll run microbench: routing top_k sweep (2,4,6,8,12) across seq_lens [512,2048,8192] measuring avg token latency, p99, and GPU mem allocs. Spinning up a canary job now.
Sam: Also try router logit scaling (0.6-0.9). Downscaling logits reduces spread so fewer diverse experts get picked — can improve load balance if a few experts are hot.
Priya: Add 'expert_load_balancer: per_batch_randomize' and export metric 'router_entropy' so we can track imbalance.
Alex: Planned experiments: A) top_k sweep B) logit_scale sweep C) expert_cache_capacity bump D) kernel hint to force fused vs tiled. Listing configs for canary.
Alex: Example canary command:
```
rls-canary create --model mixtral-moe-v2 --config '
router.top_k=4
router.logit_scale=0.8
expert_cache.capacity=8192
kernel.override=prefer_fused_attention
'
```
perf-bot: Scheduled canary: rls-canary-542 on infra-prod-usw2. Start 1719003600 ETA ~10m.
Danielle: If canary drops p99 but ups median, consider adaptive top_k based on seq_len or token_entropy.
Marco: :thumbsup: I'll capture kernel selection traces and upload flamegraphs to #eng-runtime later.
Sam: Also validate quantization fallbacks — some kernels fallback to unoptimized fp32 paths when activation scale changes, which can explain regressions.
Priya: Add Llama/Mistral/Qwen baselines to ensure model-specific knobs aren't the root cause.
Alex: Thanks all — will update when canary finishes. Pushing perf logs to /mnt/ci/perf/1719001234_mixtral_router for traces and raw profiles.
